content.text:
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* NMOS reference and PMOS mirror reference, both nominally 10 uA
XNR IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
XNB PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
XPB PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 m=1
* NMOS input pair with a 50 uA tail and PMOS current-mirror load
XNT NTL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=3
XNT2 NTL IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=50 l=1 m=1
RTB VDD VBC 100meg
RBB VBC VSS 100meg
XTC TAIL VBC NTL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=6
XNI ND VINN TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=97.4 l=1 m=7
XNI2 X VINP TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=97.4 l=1 m=7
XPL ND ND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=3
XPM X ND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=85 l=1 m=3
XPCOMP X PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=40 l=1 m=1
* Small supply-sensing sink trims output-stage line feedthrough
RFF1 VDD VFF 4.89meg
RFF2 VFF IBIAS 1.5meg
RFF3 VFF VSS 2.5meg
XFF X VFF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=24 l=2.5 m=1
* Class-A output pull-up and large NMOS pull-down
XPO VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 m=11
XPO2 VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=43 l=1 m=1
XNO VOUT X VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 m=14
* Miller compensation with a series nulling resistor
RZ X NC 330
CC NC VOUT 20p
.ends DUT
